quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Maria said, "I walk to school every day."
quests.reportedSpeech: Maria said that she walked to school every day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Walk' backshifts to 'walked', and 'I' becomes 'she' because Maria is the speaker being reported.
quests.nativeTip: Check what happens to the verb tense and to the pronoun 'I' when Maria's own words are reported.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Maria said, "I walk to school every day."" ➔ "Maria said that she walked to school every day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Daniel said, "I play the guitar on weekends."
quests.reportedSpeech: Daniel said that he played the guitar on weekends.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Play' shifts back to 'played', and 'I' changes to 'he' since we are reporting Daniel's statement.
quests.nativeTip: Look for two changes: the verb moves one step into the past, and 'I' becomes a pronoun referring to Daniel.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Daniel said, "I play the guitar on weekends."" ➔ "Daniel said that he played the guitar on weekends."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Pronoun Reference Shift
quests.directSpeech: Grace said, "I live near the station."
quests.reportedSpeech: Grace said that she lived near the station.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Live' shifts to 'lived', and the subject pronoun 'I' becomes the subject pronoun 'she', not the possessive 'her'.
quests.nativeTip: Decide whether you need a subject pronoun ('she') or a possessive ('her'), and remember present simple moves one step back.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Grace said, "I live near the station."" ➔ "Grace said that she lived near the station."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Omar said, "I am waiting for the bus."
quests.reportedSpeech: Omar said that he was waiting for the bus.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am waiting' (present continuous) shifts to 'was waiting' (past continuous); 'I' becomes 'he' since Omar is being reported.
quests.nativeTip: 'Am' is part of the present continuous — think about what it becomes in the past, and who 'I' refers to.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Omar said, "I am waiting for the bus."" ➔ "Omar said that he was waiting for the bus."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Fatima said, "I am cooking dinner."
quests.reportedSpeech: Fatima said that she was cooking dinner.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am cooking' becomes 'was cooking' — the auxiliary changes but the '-ing' form stays; 'I' becomes 'she'.
quests.nativeTip: The auxiliary 'am' must shift, but keep the '-ing' form of the verb.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Fatima said, "I am cooking dinner."" ➔ "Fatima said that she was cooking dinner."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Kwame said, "I am reading a good book."
quests.reportedSpeech: Kwame said that he was reading a good book.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am reading' shifts to 'was reading', and 'I' becomes 'he' because Kwame is the one being quoted.
quests.nativeTip: Two changes are needed: the continuous auxiliary and the pronoun referring to Kwame.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Kwame said, "I am reading a good book."" ➔ "Kwame said that he was reading a good book."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Possessive Shift
quests.directSpeech: Elena said, "My brother works at the hospital."
quests.reportedSpeech: Elena said that her brother worked at the hospital.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'My' becomes 'her' because Elena is the speaker, and 'works' backshifts to 'worked'.
quests.nativeTip: 'My' belongs to Elena, so think about which possessive pronoun refers to her; also check the verb tense.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Elena said, "My brother works at the hospital."" ➔ "Elena said that her brother worked at the hospital."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Possessive Shift
quests.directSpeech: Marcus said, "My car needs a repair."
quests.reportedSpeech: Marcus said that his car needed a repair.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'My' shifts to 'his' since Marcus owns the car, and 'needs' shifts to 'needed'.
quests.nativeTip: Identify who 'my' refers to before choosing the possessive pronoun.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Marcus said, "My car needs a repair."" ➔ "Marcus said that his car needed a repair."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Possessive Shift
quests.directSpeech: Nadia said, "My parents live in Portugal."
quests.reportedSpeech: Nadia said that her parents lived in Portugal.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'My' refers to Nadia, so it becomes 'her' regardless of 'parents' being plural; 'live' backshifts to 'lived'.
quests.nativeTip: The possessive pronoun depends on who is speaking, not on whether the noun after it is plural.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Nadia said, "My parents live in Portugal."" ➔ "Nadia said that her parents lived in Portugal."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Victor said, "I am tired after work."
quests.reportedSpeech: Victor said that he was tired after work.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am' becomes 'was' with the singular pronoun 'he', and 'I' changes to 'he'.
quests.nativeTip: Match the pronoun to the correct past form of 'to be': was or were?
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Victor said, "I am tired after work."" ➔ "Victor said that he was tired after work."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Isabella said, "The lake is very cold."
quests.reportedSpeech: Isabella said that the lake was very cold.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Is' shifts to 'was' because the subject 'the lake' is singular; no pronoun change is needed here.
quests.nativeTip: This subject is not 'I' — focus only on the correct past form of 'to be'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Isabella said, "The lake is very cold."" ➔ "Isabella said that the lake was very cold."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Hassan said, "I am ready for the interview."
quests.reportedSpeech: Hassan said that he was ready for the interview.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am' becomes 'was', and 'I' becomes 'he' since Hassan is being reported.
quests.nativeTip: Apply both changes you have practiced: the verb 'to be' and the pronoun 'I'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Hassan said, "I am ready for the interview."" ➔ "Hassan said that he was ready for the interview."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Sofia said, "I don't like spicy food."
quests.reportedSpeech: Sofia said that she didn't like spicy food.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Don't like' shifts to 'didn't like', and 'I' becomes 'she'.
quests.nativeTip: Negative present simple uses 'don't' or 'doesn't' — what does this become in the past?
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Sofia said, "I don't like spicy food."" ➔ "Sofia said that she didn't like spicy food."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Possessive Shift
quests.directSpeech: Ravi said, "My sister doesn't drive."
quests.reportedSpeech: Ravi said that his sister didn't drive.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'My' becomes 'his', and 'doesn't drive' becomes 'didn't drive'.
quests.nativeTip: Two things change here: the possessive pronoun and the negative auxiliary.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Ravi said, "My sister doesn't drive."" ➔ "Ravi said that his sister didn't drive."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Clara said, "I don't understand the exercise."
quests.reportedSpeech: Clara said that she didn't understand the exercise.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Don't understand' becomes 'didn't understand', and 'I' becomes 'she'.
quests.nativeTip: Combine the pronoun change with the negative backshift you just practiced.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Clara said, "I don't understand the exercise."" ➔ "Clara said that she didn't understand the exercise."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Pronoun Reference Shift
quests.directSpeech: The twins said, "We enjoy hiking."
quests.reportedSpeech: The twins said that they enjoyed hiking.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' becomes 'they' because the twins are being referred to from outside, and 'enjoy' backshifts to 'enjoyed'.
quests.nativeTip: 'We' refers to the twins themselves — what pronoun replaces it when their words are reported by someone else?
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The twins said, "We enjoy hiking."" ➔ "The twins said that they enjoyed hiking."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Pronoun Reference Shift
quests.directSpeech: My neighbors said, "We are moving to a new apartment."
quests.reportedSpeech: My neighbors said that they were moving to a new apartment.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' becomes 'they', and 'are moving' backshifts to 'were moving'.
quests.nativeTip: Apply the same 'we' → 'they' rule together with the present continuous backshift.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "My neighbors said, "We are moving to a new apartment."" ➔ "My neighbors said that they were moving to a new apartment."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Pronoun Reference Shift
quests.directSpeech: The coaches said, "We train every morning."
quests.reportedSpeech: The coaches said that they trained every morning.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' becomes 'they', and 'train' backshifts to 'trained'.
quests.nativeTip: Third-person reporting always replaces 'we' with the same pronoun — which one?
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The coaches said, "We train every morning."" ➔ "The coaches said that they trained every morning."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Possessive Shift
quests.directSpeech: The students said, "Our teacher is very patient."
quests.reportedSpeech: The students said that their teacher was very patient.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Our' becomes 'their', and 'is' backshifts to 'was'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Our' belongs to the students — decide which possessive pronoun replaces it.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The students said, "Our teacher is very patient."" ➔ "The students said that their teacher was very patient."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Possessive Shift
quests.directSpeech: The players said, "Our team plays well together."
quests.reportedSpeech: The players said that their team played well together.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Our' becomes 'their', and 'plays' backshifts to 'played'.
quests.nativeTip: Keep both rules in mind: the possessive pronoun and the tense of 'play'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The players said, "Our team plays well together."" ➔ "The players said that their team played well together."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Possessive Shift
quests.directSpeech: The workers said, "Our manager is very fair."
quests.reportedSpeech: The workers said that their manager was very fair.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Our' becomes 'their', and 'is' backshifts to 'was'.
quests.nativeTip: Same pattern again — check the possessive pronoun and the verb 'to be'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The workers said, "Our manager is very fair."" ➔ "The workers said that their manager was very fair."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Yuki said, "I lose my keys all the time."
quests.reportedSpeech: Yuki said that she lost her keys all the time.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'I' becomes 'she' and 'my' becomes 'her'; 'lose' backshifts to 'lost'.
quests.nativeTip: Both the pronoun and the possessive belong to Yuki — check each one separately.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Yuki said, "I lose my keys all the time."" ➔ "Yuki said that she lost her keys all the time."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Liam said, "I forget my umbrella every winter."
quests.reportedSpeech: Liam said that he forgot his umbrella every winter.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'I' becomes 'he', 'my' becomes 'his', and 'forget' backshifts to 'forgot'.
quests.nativeTip: Two separate words need to change to match Liam: the subject pronoun and the possessive.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Liam said, "I forget my umbrella every winter."" ➔ "Liam said that he forgot his umbrella every winter."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Aisha said, "I love my job."
quests.reportedSpeech: Aisha said that she loved her job.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'I' becomes 'she', 'my' becomes 'her', and 'love' backshifts to 'loved'.
quests.nativeTip: Change the pronoun, the possessive, and the tense — three small steps in one sentence.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Aisha said, "I love my job."" ➔ "Aisha said that she loved her job."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: The manager said, "The project is behind schedule."
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager said that the project was behind schedule.
quests.ruleExplanation: Only the verb 'to be' backshifts from 'is' to 'was'; there is no pronoun to change here.
quests.nativeTip: Not every reported sentence needs a pronoun change — check only what actually needs to move.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said, "The project is behind schedule."" ➔ "The manager said that the project was behind schedule."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Diego said, "I am learning to swim."
quests.reportedSpeech: Diego said that he was learning to swim.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am learning' becomes 'was learning', and 'I' becomes 'he'.
quests.nativeTip: Keep the continuous form intact — only the auxiliary and the pronoun move.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Diego said, "I am learning to swim."" ➔ "Diego said that he was learning to swim."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Possessive Shift
quests.directSpeech: Amara said, "My flight leaves early."
quests.reportedSpeech: Amara said that her flight left early.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'My' becomes 'her' and 'leaves' backshifts to 'left'.
quests.nativeTip: Whose flight is it? Choose the possessive that matches the speaker, and backshift the verb.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Amara said, "My flight leaves early."" ➔ "Amara said that her flight left early."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Felix said, "I am the new manager."
quests.reportedSpeech: Felix said that he was the new manager.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am' becomes 'was', and 'I' becomes 'he'.
quests.nativeTip: This combines two of the very first rules you learned — find both of them.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Felix said, "I am the new manager."" ➔ "Felix said that he was the new manager."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Pronoun Reference Shift
quests.directSpeech: The children said, "We don't want to leave yet."
quests.reportedSpeech: The children said that they didn't want to leave yet.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' becomes 'they', and 'don't want' becomes 'didn't want'.
quests.nativeTip: Recall how 'we' changes when someone else reports a group's words, and how negatives shift tense.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The children said, "We don't want to leave yet."" ➔ "The children said that they didn't want to leave yet."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Zara said, "My phone is not working properly."
quests.reportedSpeech: Zara said that her phone was not working properly.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'My' becomes 'her', and 'is not working' becomes 'was not working'.
quests.nativeTip: This question checks three things at once: the possessive, the verb 'to be', and the continuous form.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Zara said, "My phone is not working properly."" ➔ "Zara said that her phone was not working properly."
